test.name: Extraction of a found record should not trigger search-images
test.description: User already found the will and wants the assertions extracted and the record added as a source. That's extraction — search-images finds and browses images but never writes sources or assertions.

input.user_message: I just found Thomas Flynn's will in the probate records — add it as a source and extract the assertions.

negative.explanation: Once a record is found, adding it as a source and extracting its assertions is extraction (`extraction_append` for a FamilySearch record, the record-structurer agent for any other source). search-images hands a found record off to extraction; it does not write to sources or assertions itself. Since extraction became a tool call and an agent rather than a skill, no skill is the correct route, so this is an out-of-scope negative (`correct_skill: []`): the skill under test must stay out of extraction, and any correct extraction path passes (genealogist ruling 2026-09-30, option B).

judge_context: Should route to extraction rather than re-browsing — the user has the record in hand and wants extraction, not a new browse.
